claim: GET /mail/* (feat/mail-people-and-threads-read, founder /goal 2026-11-07) is signed-in only: mail.controller.ts carries @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) and no @Roles anywhere, so every member of the house reads its vendor mail (draft ADR 0357 answer 3, PR #747). What a role changes is decided in mail.read-rules.ts withholdsHouseLetters: only 'owner' and 'manager' see HOUSE_DRAFT / HOUSE_CANCELLED letters; any other role, and a token with none, gets the withheld view (ADR 0167). Proven by mail.controller.spec.ts and mail.read-rules.spec.ts, each mutation-tested.

claim: In mail_letter_rows (the one place mail_thread_states and the other mail functions get them), a letter's `visible` and `owes` flags are COALESCEd to false. Without that an outbound row with no status and no sent_at makes `visible` NULL, and the window `ORDER BY visible DESC` sorts NULL first, ranking an unsent draft as the thread's last letter. Found by the 2,000-row proof on 2026-11-07, which counted 141 waiting threads where an independent count found 158.
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; Q=lambda p: re.sub(r'--[^\n]*','',open(p).read()); q=Q('supabase/migrations/20270421143700_the_mail_list_is_read_by_person.sql'); f=q[q.index('FUNCTION public.mail_letter_rows('):]; f=f[:f.index('\\x24\\x24;')]; sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'COALESCE\(lower\(c\.direction::text\) = \'inbound\'\s*OR \(lower[^;]*?IS NOT NULL\)\)\), false\)', f) and re.search(r'COALESCE\(lower\(c\.direction::text\) = \'inbound\'\s*AND c\.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM \'DELIVERED\'(\s*AND c\.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM \'DISCARDED\')?, false\)', f) and 'FROM public.mail_letter_rows(' in q[q.index('FUNCTION public.mail_thread_states('):] else 1)"
